item.description: This 2024 Ram 1500 TRX Crew Cab 4×4 is one of a planned 4,000 Final Edition examples to commemorate the end of production of the 1500 TRX, and it now has 3,300 miles. The truck is finished in Delmonico Red Pearl over black leather and microsuede and is powered by a supercharged 6.2-liter Hemi V8 linked with an eight-speed automatic transmission, a full-time two-speed transfer case, and an electronically locking rear differential. item.description: This 2014 BMW 650i xDrive Gran Coupe has 45k miles, and it was registered with one prior owner until it was purchased in 2025 by the seller. item.title: 5k-Mile 1990 Chevrolet Corvette ZR-1 at No Reserve
item.description: This 1990 Chevrolet Corvette ZR-1 was acquired by the seller on BaT in April 2017 and has since been driven approximately 3,300 of its 5k miles.
